prompt: A fruit seller buys oranges at 3 for $2 and sells them at 4 for $3. What is the seller's profit, as a percent of the cost?
A traveler changes $400 into euros at a rate of 0.90 euro per dollar. Later she changes all of those euros back into dollars at a rate of 1.05 dollars per euro. How many dollars has she lost overall?

Kai drove for 2 hours at an average speed of 45 miles per hour. At what average speed, in miles per hour, must he drive for the next 3 hours so that his average speed for the whole 5 hours is 54 miles per hour?

Working together, Ana and Ben can paint a fence in 30 hours, Ben and Cal can paint it in 20 hours, and Ana and Cal can paint it in 15 hours. Each person always works at his or her own steady rate. How many hours would Ana take to paint the fence working alone?

A dog is chasing a rabbit that is 60 of the rabbit's leaps ahead of it. In the time the dog takes 3 leaps, the rabbit takes 4 leaps. Two of the dog's leaps cover the same distance as 3 of the rabbit's leaps. Both keep these paces. How many leaps must the dog take to catch the rabbit?

Running without a break, a pump would empty a pond in exactly 6 hours. Instead, the pump runs for 50 minutes, rests for 10 minutes, runs for 50 minutes, rests for 10 minutes, and so on, always pumping at the same rate while it runs. Starting with a full pond and the pump just switched on, how long does it take to empty the pond?

Train A leaves station P at 9:00 a.m. and travels toward station Q. Train B leaves station Q at 9:40 a.m. and travels toward P on a parallel track, at a speed 20 kilometers per hour greater than train A's. Each train keeps a constant speed. The trains pass each other at 12:00 noon, exactly halfway between P and Q. What is train A's speed, in kilometers per hour?

A train moving at a constant speed passes a man walking beside the track in the same direction as the train in 15 seconds, and passes a woman walking beside the track toward the train in 12 seconds. (Each pass lasts from when the front of the train reaches the person until the back of the train passes the person.) Each person walks at 1 meter per second. How many meters long is the train?

Two cars leave towns P and Q at the same moment and drive toward each other on the same road, each at its own constant speed. After they pass each other, the car from P needs 4 more hours to reach Q, and the car from Q needs 9 more hours to reach P. How many hours after they started did the cars pass each other?
Ana has 50 percent more money than Ben. Ana gives some of her money to Ben, and then they have equal amounts. What percent of her original money did Ana give to Ben?

A courier charges $5.00 to ship a package that weighs up to 1 kilogram, plus $2.00 for each additional half kilogram or part of a half kilogram. How many dollars does it cost to ship a package that weighs 3.2 kilograms?

One worker alone would need 50 days to finish a job. On the first day, one worker works on the job; on the second day a second worker joins, on the third day a third worker joins, and so on, with one more worker joining each day. All the workers work at the same steady rate. On which day is the job finished?

A caterer charges a fixed fee plus the same price for each guest. A party for 40 guests costs $1,100 and a party for 60 guests costs $1,500. For how many guests would the average cost per guest be exactly $22?

Three partners share $1,260. Partner A receives one third as much as partners B and C together, and partner B receives two sevenths as much as partners A and C together. How many dollars does partner C receive?

Ali brings 5 loaves of bread and Bo brings 7 loaves. They share all 12 loaves equally with Cy and Dee, who brought none. Cy and Dee together pay $24 for the bread they ate, and Ali and Bo divide the $24 fairly, in proportion to how much of Cy's and Dee's bread each of them supplied. How many dollars does Ali get?

In trapezoid ABCD, side AB is parallel to side CD, AB = 4 and CD = 10. The diagonals AC and BD meet at point E. The area of triangle ABE is 8 square units. What is the area of trapezoid ABCD, in square units?

A rectangular sheet of paper is 16 inches long and 12 inches wide. It is folded once so that one corner lands exactly on the opposite corner. The crease crosses each 16-inch side. On the 16-inch side that contains the corner that was moved, how far, in inches, is the crease from that corner?

Two circles rest on the same straight line, each touching the line at one point, and the two circles touch each other at one point. The smaller circle has radius 4. The points where the circles touch the line are 12 units apart. What is the radius of the larger circle?

Square P has sides 10 centimeters long and square Q has sides 14 centimeters long. Square Q is placed so that one of its vertices is at the center of square P, and it is turned about that vertex to a position in which no side of Q is parallel to a side of P. What is the area, in square centimeters, of the region that lies inside both squares?

A sector of a circle (the region bounded by two radii and the arc between them) has radius 6 centimeters. The perimeter of the sector, which is the two radii plus the arc, is 20 centimeters. What is the area of the sector, in square centimeters?
An isosceles trapezoid has parallel sides of lengths 8 and 18, and a circle can be drawn inside it that touches all four of its sides. What is the height of the trapezoid?

A round pizza is cut into 8 equal slices by cuts through its center. Each slice has an area of 8π square inches. What is the perimeter, in inches, of one slice (the two straight edges and the curved crust edge)?

Two circles have the same center. A chord of the larger circle is 12 units long and touches the smaller circle at exactly one point. What is the area of the region inside the larger circle and outside the smaller circle?

A solid cube has edges 6 centimeters long. A square hole with sides 2 centimeters long is cut straight through the cube, from the center of one face to the center of the opposite face, with its sides parallel to the edges of the cube. What is the total surface area, in square centimeters, of the solid that remains, including the inside of the hole?

Solid cubes with edges 2 inches long are packed, without being cut, into a closed rectangular box whose inside measures 5 inches by 7 inches by 9 inches. Every cube must have its edges parallel to the edges of the box. What is the greatest number of cubes that can fit in the box?
In a right triangle, one leg is 5 centimeters long and the median from the right angle to the hypotenuse is 6.5 centimeters long. What is the area of the triangle, in square centimeters?
An isosceles trapezoid has parallel sides 8 and 14 units long, and its two diagonals are perpendicular to each other. What is the area of the trapezoid?
For how many whole numbers n is the measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon with n sides a whole number of degrees?
In the coordinate plane, the points (-1, 1) and (7, 5) are opposite vertices of a square. Which of the following is another vertex of the square?
In the coordinate plane, R is the set of points (x, y) with 0 <= x <= 6 and 0 <= y <= 6 that satisfy both y >= x - 2 and y <= x + 3. What is the area of R?

Ten identical pencils are to be given out to Ava, Ben and Cara so that each of them receives at least 2 pencils and all ten pencils are given out. In how many different ways can this be done? (Two ways are different if at least one person receives a different number of pencils.)
The mean of six numbers is 15. One of the six numbers is replaced by 31, and the mean of the six numbers becomes 17. What number was replaced?
In a survey of 100 people, 85 said they like apples, 75 said they like bananas and 60 said they like cherries. What is the least possible number of the people surveyed who like all three fruits?
Five points are marked on line l, and four points are marked on a different line m that is parallel to l. How many triangles have all three of their vertices among these nine points?

A club has 9 members. It will choose a president, a treasurer and a 2-person planning committee. The president and the treasurer must be different people, and neither of them may serve on the committee. In how many different ways can these choices be made?
Two different integers are chosen at random from the integers 1 through 11, inclusive, with every pair equally likely. What is the probability that the sum of the two integers is divisible by 3?
Four married couples attend a meeting. Three of the eight people are chosen at random to give a short speech. What is the probability that no two of the three people chosen are married to each other?
A fair coin is tossed 6 times. What is the probability that the number of heads is greater than the number of tails?
Six identical red flags and four identical blue flags are to be hung in a row. How many different arrangements have no two blue flags next to each other?
Three different integers are chosen at random from the integers 1 through 9, inclusive, with every group of three equally likely. What is the probability that the sum of the three integers is even?

The probability of rain on Saturday is 40 percent and the probability of rain on Sunday is 30 percent, and rain on one day does not affect rain on the other. What is the probability that it rains on exactly one of the two days?

A box holds 6 light bulbs, and exactly 2 of them are defective. The bulbs are tested one at a time, in a random order, until both defective bulbs have been found. What is the probability that exactly 4 bulbs are tested?
Four different books are to be placed into three different boxes so that no box is left empty. In how many different ways can this be done? (The order of the books inside a box does not matter.)
A function f satisfies f(x) + 2f(1 - x) = 5x + 1 for every number x. What is the value of f(0)?
In an arithmetic sequence, the first term is 48, and the sum of the first 10 terms is equal to the sum of the first 15 terms. What is the 20th term of the sequence?
The function f is defined by f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 1. For what value of a is f(a) equal to f(a + 4) ?

The positive integers are written in rows: row 1 is 1; row 2 is 2, 3; row 3 is 4, 5, 6; and so on, with each row containing one more integer than the row before it and the integers continuing in order. What is the sum of the integers in row 20?
The numbers a and b satisfy a + b = 10 and ab = 20. What is the value of 1/a^2 + 1/b^2 ?
The nonzero numbers x and y satisfy 2/x + 3/y = 2 and 4/x - 3/y = 1. What is the value of x + y ?
A sequence begins with the numbers 3 and x, in that order, and each term after the second is the sum of the two terms just before it. The sixth term of the sequence is 41. What is the value of x?
A function f satisfies f(0) = 3 and f(x + 1) = f(x) + 2x + 1 for every number x. What is the value of f(10)?
The sequence 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1, 2, ... rises from 1 to 4, falls back to 1, rises to 4 again, and so on. What is the sum of the first 101 terms?

Mina spent half of her money plus 3 dollars at a bookstore. She then spent one third of the money she had left plus 2 dollars at a cafe. After that she had 10 dollars left. How many dollars did Mina have at the start?
The positive numbers x and y satisfy x^2 y = 50 and x y^2 = 20. What is the value of xy ?
The number N is formed by writing the whole numbers from 10 to 50 in order with no spaces, so N = 101112131415...484950. What is the remainder when N is divided by 99?
For how many positive integers n is (n + 40)/(n + 4) an integer?
The numbers p and q are prime numbers, and p^2 - q^2 = 72. What is the greatest possible value of p?
Each digit of a three-digit number is even (0, 2, 4, 6 or 8), and the number is divisible by 9. How many such three-digit numbers are there?
A palindrome is a number that reads the same forward and backward, such as 3443. How many four-digit palindromes are divisible by 7?
What is the value of 0.666... divided by 0.060606... ? (In 0.666... the digit 6 repeats forever; in 0.060606... the block 06 repeats forever.)
What is the square root of 6.4 x 10^11, written in scientific notation?
What is the greatest integer that divides the product of ANY five consecutive odd positive integers, such as 7, 9, 11, 13 and 15?
